title: AI assistant
intro: Ask me anything about Boston parking tickets. To check your own tickets, search the official site and upload a screenshot of the results page.
readonly: Read-only assistant: it never visits websites for you or submits anything. Screenshots are used for this answer only and are not kept on the server.
placeholder: Ask a question, e.g. Is my latest ticket overdue?
suggest1: When was my latest ticket? Is it overdue?
suggest2: How long do I have to pay or appeal?
suggest3: How do I appeal a parking ticket?
appealPhoto: This ticket isn't in the demo system. Tap “Ticket photo” and photograph it to start an appeal.
overdue: {days} days overdue (due {date}): a late fee is added, but you can still appeal
